correctness.rationale: Maximal independent sets are in bijection with uncovered subsets U,V of allowed non-singleton complements plus the unique all-pure set. The token graph neighborhood structure yields both directions. Size is F=C(m,2)+u(n-m)+(b-u)(b-u-1)/2; equality conditions prove the cases and multiplicities, including the m=n=2 boundary. Independent graph-based exhaustive verifier checked 15 instances and 6,947 sets, but finite checks are not generalized certificates.

originality.rationale: The labelled maximal-stable-set cardinality enumerator, exact minimum independent domination and all minimizer multiplicities are not stated in the inspected primary sources or published research-index matches. This is a constrained refinement of the all-dominating-set criterion of arXiv:2610.31557 Lemma 2.2, and both ordinary domination and general maximal-independent-set constructions are credited; no assertion of absolute priority is made.
residual_risks: Earlier papers or inaccessible sources may encode the same enumerator under maximal stable sets, minimal vertex covers, independent domination, symmetric-square, or complete-bipartite token graph terminology.

The classification is closely connected to the broad all-dominating-set criterion in arXiv:2610.31557 Lemma 2.2, which appeared after the eligible focal source but before the current analysis. The novelty and mathematical significance of this specialization require external historical review.

value.rationale: The complete labelled all-cardinality maximal-independent-set distribution, sharp independent-domination number and minimizer counts form a motivated exact classification of an infinite host family with newly studied ordinary domination. In the balanced case independent domination grows quadratically while ordinary domination grows linearly. The result is more than an isolated small computation or a renaming of alpha/gamma, although it is a specialization of a recent broad domination characterization.
